# ConFuse

ConFuse is a developer platform that unifies your repositories with AI for better microservices development. It connects repositories, documentation, and external resources to give your development environment instant, complete understanding of your architecture.

## Features

- Multi-Source Connection: Integrate repositories and documentation natively
- Immutable Context: Versioned, synced, and immutable architecture knowledge
- Granular Security: Row-level security and explicit scoping
- Low-Latency Retrieval: Sub-10ms response times for complex queries

## Integrations

50+ integrations including GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Notion, Slack, Figma, Google Drive, and more.

## Documentation

Full documentation available at https://confuse.site/docs
